An '''Adamite Signet Rings''' was a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] ring made and worn by a member of the [[Paladins of the Adamite Tower]] on the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. It was created by a novice to the order using an ancient [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], referred to as a sunfire sword, to cut a durasteel fitting in the lower levels of the remains of a crashed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and base of the Paladins known as [[Adamite Tower]]. The novice would carve the crest of the Adamite Tower into the ring, which signifies the wearer as a member of the order. If someone were to possess an Adamite Signet Ring under false pretense they would be considered an enemy of the Paladins of the Adamite Tower.<ref name="NoP" />
